review_type: Separate assistant label review; not independent human clinical validation
label_author: Coding assistant that designed the corpus
reviewer: Root session assistant, separate from the corpus author assistant; shared development context
reviewer_model: Session assistant; exact model revision unavailable
blinding_record: Reviewer declared answer key was withheld until task prompt and predictions were archived; isolation is self-declared, not verified by model execution logs
metadata_correction: After predictions were frozen, prompt_sha256 was corrected from the instructions-only template hash to the exact archived task prompt plus corpus hash. No labels or rationales changed. CLI archive integrity was then verified.
source_fidelity: Corpus author inspected original retrieved responses. The separate reviewer assessed the supplied paraphrases rather than independently re-extracting the full original documents. Original HTTP-byte SHA-256 checksums and exact locators are in sources.json.
limitations: Public author-designed development set, not held out
Four sources reused across 24 correlated cases
Three sources concern the same ACTT-1/remdesivir program
Short author paraphrases reduce extraction and interpretation difficulty
Task prompt/corpus archive does not reconstruct the entire shared session
Historical FDA passage does not establish a current product label
